verdict.rationale: Founder equity mechanics are a fair question for a law firm that advises start-ups, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows CAM's own materials covering vesting schedules, 83(b) or the Indian equivalent, or co-founder equity splits. The closest items are a generic note on helping startups standardize key documents and an employment page with no ESOP-specific content, and neither addresses day-zero ownership setup.
